scope: Catalog reconciliation: remaining distinct cast-exclusive and boss/raid skill gaps

records.name: Celestial Hammer
records.effect: Fused Zamasu charges and slams the opponent with a fist, sending them flying.

records.name: Giant Storm
records.effect: Creates a large tracking explosion beneath the opponent.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.effect: Grab attack followed by a Ki Wave slam; leaves the user open.

records.name: Bloody Sauce
records.effect: Wave of purple Ki blasts; can poison or slow targets.

records.name: Spiral of Condemnation
records.effect: Three spiral energy waves fired toward the opponent.

notes: Batch 285 was reconciled against the prior batch-264 records to avoid duplicate identities. Strong dedicated Xenoverse 2 pages establish Bloody Sauce, Celestial Hammer, Spiral of Condemnation, and Gigantic Slam. Other names previously listed in this batch were already researched in batch 264 and were removed here. Duplicate identities were collapsed to one record per canonical (name, class, subcategory) key after validation. Removed Marbling Drop, Seasoning Arrow, and Time Shackles because Batch 264 already contains those identities. This batch retains only newly cataloged identities.
